verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Git sync connects a Lovable project to a repository you own on GitHub or GitLab and keeps the two in sync automatically. They also cover the reverse direction: you can clone, edit and commit locally, and push, and those changes sync back into Lovable. The docs further mention branches, pull requests and deploying outside Lovable. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that two-way sync works reliably in practice.
